modals.resetE2EWarningIntro: Warning: this action is irreversible and should only be performed if you suspect private key compromise or encryption corruption.
modals.resetE2EPoint1: Generation of a new cryptographic identity (new 2048-bit RSA key pair).
modals.resetE2EPoint2: Immediate replacement and invalidation of your previous public and private keys on the server.
modals.resetE2EPoint3: Permanent deletion of your previously encrypted messages on the server (they become undecryptable).
modals.resetE2EPoint4: Purge of this account's local history and cryptographic keys stored on this device (IndexedDB); other accounts used in this browser are not affected.
modals.resetE2EPoint5: Revocation of verification status with your contacts (they will need to re-verify your Safety Number).
modals.resetE2EPoint6: Revocation of all active sessions across devices and immediate logout.
